Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 1) A 68-year-old multiparous woman presents with a painful groin swelling situated below and lateral to the pubic tubercle. The most likely diagnosis is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Femoral hernia lies below and lateral to the pubic tubercle and commonly occurs in elderly females.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 2) Taxis is contraindicated in:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Reduction may return gangrenous bowel into the abdomen.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 3) Which hernia has the highest incidence of strangulation?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The narrow femoral ring predisposes to strangulation.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 4) An indirect inguinal hernia lies the inferior epigastric vessels.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Indirect hernias pass lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels through the deep ring.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 5) A direct inguinal hernia protrudes through:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Direct hernias occur through a weakness in Hesselbach’s triangle.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 6) Which inguinal hernia commonly descends into the scrotum?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Indirect inguinal hernias frequently extend into the scrotum.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 7) A painful irreducible groin swelling associated with vomiting should be managed by:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: This presentation suggests strangulation until proved otherwise.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 8) Which infant usually does not require immediate surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Most infantile umbilical hernias close spontaneously by 2–5 years.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 9) The standard open mesh repair for primary inguinal hernia is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lichtenstein tension-free mesh repair is the standard open technique.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 10) Mesh repair is generally avoided in:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Mesh infection risk is high in contaminated surgery.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 11) The strongest predisposing factor for incisional hernia is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Wound infection significantly impairs fascial healing.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 12) A swelling developing through a previous laparotomy scar is most likely:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Incisional hernia develops at the site of a previous surgical incision.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 13) Which hernia should be suspected in an elderly thin woman presenting with intestinal obstruction but no obvious groin swelling?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Obturator hernia classically presents this way.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 14) Which hernia may strangulate without causing complete intestinal obstruction?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Only part of the bowel circumference is involved.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 15) A hernia containing Meckel’s diverticulum is called:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Littre’s hernia contains a Meckel’s diverticulum. Subtopic 5: Hernia, Skin Tumours/Cysts, Hospital Infection & Ethics

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 16) Which ligament forms the medial boundary of the femoral ring?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The lacunar (Gimbernat’s) ligament forms the medial boundary of the femoral ring.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 17) Which statement regarding direct inguinal hernia is correct?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: It lies medial to the inferior epigastric vessels
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: It commonly descends into the scrotum
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: It passes through the deep inguinal ring
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Direct inguinal hernias protrude through Hesselbach’s triangle medial to the inferior epigastric vessels.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 18) A painless, soft, lobulated swelling showing a positive slip sign is most likely:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Slip sign is a characteristic clinical feature of lipoma.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 19) Which clinical feature is characteristic of a sebaceous (epidermoid) cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A central punctum represents the blocked pilosebaceous duct.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 20) The treatment of choice for a non-infected sebaceous cyst is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Complete excision with the cyst wall
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Complete excision prevents recurrence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 21) The commonest benign soft tissue tumour is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lipoma is the most common benign mesenchymal tumour.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 22) A rapidly enlarging painless soft tissue mass should be considered:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Rapid enlargement raises suspicion of soft tissue sarcoma.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 23) The most appropriate initial investigation for a suspected soft tissue sarcoma is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: MRI best defines tumour extent and relation to adjacent structures.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 24) Which of the following is the single most effective measure to reduce hospital-acquired infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Proper hand hygiene remains the cornerstone of infection control.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 25) The commonest route of transmission of nosocomial infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Direct and indirect contact account for most hospital-acquired infections.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 26) Which hospital-acquired infection is encountered most frequently?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Catheter-associated urinary tract infection is the commonest HAI.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 27) Surgical antibiotic prophylaxis is most effective when administered:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The highest tissue concentration should be present at the time of incision.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 28) Which sterilization method is preferred for heat-sensitive instruments?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Ethylene oxide is used for heat- and moisture-sensitive equipment.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 29) Which sterilization method reliably destroys bacterial spores?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Steam under pressure is the standard method for sterilization.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 30) A competent adult refuses a life-saving operation. The surgeon should:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A competent adult has the legal right to refuse treatment, even if the decision may result in death.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 31) Which of the following best defines a clean surgical wound?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Elective operation without entry into the respiratory, alimentary or genitourinary tract
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Operation involving controlled entry into the colon
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Fresh traumatic wound less than 6 hours old
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A clean wound is an uninfected operative wound in which no inflammation is encountered and the respiratory, gastrointestinal, genital or urinary tract is not entered. Examples include thyroidectomy and hernioplasty. Clean wounds have the lowest risk of surgical site infection (SSI), usually less than 2%.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 32) Which operation is classified as a clean-contaminated procedure?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Clean-contaminated operations involve controlled entry into the respiratory, alimentary, genital or urinary tract without unusual contamination. Elective biliary surgery is a classic example. Incision and drainage of an abscess is a contaminated or dirty procedure.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 33) Which of the following is NOT an indication for prophylactic antibiotics?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Routine prophylactic antibiotics are not recommended for most clean minor procedures such as lipoma excision. They are indicated when prosthetic material is implanted or when contamination is expected, such as colorectal surgery.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 34) The most common source of microorganisms causing surgical site infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Most surgical site infections originate from the patient’s own skin or mucosal flora. Proper skin preparation and aseptic technique reduce this risk. Exogenous contamination is less common with modern operating theatre practices.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 35) Which of the following is the most important risk factor for catheter-associated urinary tract infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The risk of catheter-associated UTI increases with every additional day the catheter remains in place. Therefore, urinary catheters should be inserted only when indicated and removed as early as possible.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 36) Which antiseptic has the greatest residual antimicrobial activity on the skin?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Chlorhexidine acts rapidly and continues to suppress bacterial growth for several hours after application. Alcohol works quickly but has little residual effect, making chlorhexidine preferable for surgical skin preparation.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 37) Which healthcare-associated infection is most closely related to mechanical ventilation?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Ventilator-associated pneumonia develops 48 hours or more after endotracheal intubation. Strict infection-control measures, oral care and minimizing ventilator duration reduce its incidence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 38) A patient signs a consent form without understanding the procedure or its complications. The consent is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A signature alone does not constitute informed consent. The patient must receive adequate information regarding the diagnosis, procedure, benefits, risks and alternatives, and must understand this information before voluntarily consenting.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 39) During surgery, an unexpected lesion requiring a more extensive procedure is found. If the patient had not consented to it and there is no immediate threat to life, the surgeon should:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Limit the operation and obtain informed consent before further surgery
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Wake the patient and obtain consent later
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Obtain verbal consent from a relative during surgery
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Patient autonomy should be respected. Unless delaying treatment would endanger life or cause serious harm, additional procedures require the patient’s own informed consent before proceeding.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 40) Which of the following best describes medical negligence?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Failure to provide the standard of care expected of a reasonably competent practitioner, resulting in patient harm
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Medical negligence requires four elements: duty of care, breach of that duty, resulting injury, and a causal relationship between the breach and the injury. An adverse outcome alone does not necessarily imply negligence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 41) Which of the following is an example of implied consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Signing a consent form for laparotomy
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Implied consent is inferred from a patient’s actions rather than expressed verbally or in writing. Extending the arm for blood sampling indicates agreement for the procedure. Major invasive procedures always require expressed informed consent.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 42) Which of the following patients is not legally competent to give valid consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A patient must have decision-making capacity to provide valid consent. In emergencies, when an unconscious patient requires immediate life-saving treatment, consent is presumed and treatment should not be delayed.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 43) Before elective surgery, the operating team should verify all except:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The WHO Surgical Safety Checklist requires confirmation of the correct patient, correct procedure and correct operative site. Patient religion is not part of the surgical safety verification process.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 44) Which of the following is classified as a Never Event?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Wrong-site, wrong-patient and wrong-procedure surgeries are preventable serious incidents known as Never Events. They should never occur if standard safety protocols are followed.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 45) The primary purpose of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist is to:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The WHO checklist improves communication among team members and ensures critical safety steps are completed before anaesthesia, incision and before leaving the operating room.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 46) Which of the following is the most common cause of needle-stick injury among healthcare workers?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Recapping used needles is a major cause of accidental needle-stick injuries. Current guidelines recommend immediate disposal of needles into puncture-resistant sharps containers without recapping.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 47) Following a needle-stick injury, the first step should be:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Wash the wound immediately with soap and running water
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Immediate washing reduces contamination. The incident should then be reported promptly so that risk assessment and post-exposure prophylaxis can be considered if indicated.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 48) Which blood-borne virus has the highest risk of transmission following a needle-stick injury from an infected source?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Among common occupational blood-borne infections, hepatitis B carries the highest transmission risk after percutaneous exposure. Vaccination is highly effective in preventing infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 49) Which measure provides the best protection against occupational hepatitis B infection in healthcare workers?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Complete hepatitis B vaccination with documented immunity is the most effective preventive measure. Standard precautions should still be followed for every patient.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 50) Which statement regarding patient confidentiality is correct?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Patient information may be disclosed without consent only when required by law or when overriding public interest exists.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Medical records may be discussed freely among hospital visitors.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Confidential information may be shared with relatives without permission.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Confidentiality is a fundamental ethical and legal duty. Disclosure without consent is justified only in specific circumstances, such as legal requirements or protection of public health and safety.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 51) Which of the following is the most effective method of sterilizing reusable surgical instruments?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Autoclaving uses steam under pressure (121°C, 15 psi, 15–20 minutes) and destroys bacteria, viruses and spores. It is the standard method for sterilizing metallic surgical instruments. Alcohol and chlorhexidine are disinfectants, not sterilizing agents.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 52) Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of a lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A punctum is characteristic of a sebaceous (epidermoid) cyst due to obstruction of the pilosebaceous duct. Lipomas are soft, lobulated, mobile swellings and classically demonstrate the slip sign.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 53) The commonest site of occurrence of a sebaceous (epidermoid) cyst is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sebaceous cysts occur in hair-bearing areas, especially the scalp, face, neck and back. They are absent from palms and soles because these areas lack sebaceous glands.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 54) Which feature suggests malignant transformation in a long-standing skin swelling?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Rapid increase in size with ulceration
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Rapid enlargement, ulceration, bleeding, fixation and regional lymphadenopathy are warning signs of malignancy. Such lesions require urgent biopsy and staging.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 55) Which investigation is most appropriate before definitive treatment of a suspicious skin tumour?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Histopathological examination remains the gold standard for diagnosis. FNAC may be helpful in selected lesions but cannot replace biopsy in many skin tumours.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 56) The organism most frequently responsible for an infected sebaceous cyst is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Secondary infection of sebaceous cysts is usually caused by Staphylococcus aureus. During acute infection, incision and drainage may be required before definitive excision.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 57) Which of the following is the commonest benign tumour composed of adipose tissue?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lipoma is the commonest benign tumour of mesenchymal origin. It grows slowly, is painless and rarely undergoes malignant transformation.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 58) Which clinical feature differentiates a lipoma from a sebaceous cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Slip sign is characteristic of lipoma. Sebaceous cysts are attached to the skin and usually have a central punctum, making them less mobile.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 59) Which of the following is an indication for excision of a lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Most lipomas require no treatment. Excision is advised for cosmetic reasons, pain, pressure symptoms or when malignancy cannot be excluded.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 60) Which of the following is the most common organism causing surgical site infection after clean surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: In clean surgical wounds, Staphylococcus aureus from the patient’s skin flora is the predominant pathogen. Appropriate skin preparation and aseptic technique significantly reduce infection rates.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 61) Which of the following best describes a contaminated surgical wound?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Fresh traumatic wound with major break in aseptic technique
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Contaminated wounds include fresh traumatic wounds, operations with gross spillage from the gastrointestinal tract or major breaks in sterile technique. These wounds carry a higher risk of infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 62) Which wound classification has the highest incidence of surgical site infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Dirty wounds contain established infection or devitalized tissue before surgery. They have the highest bacterial load and therefore the greatest risk of postoperative infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 63) Which of the following is the strongest modifiable risk factor for preventing surgical site infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Strict aseptic technique, meticulous surgical handling and appropriate antibiotic prophylaxis are among the most effective methods of reducing surgical site infections.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 64) Which of the following statements regarding hand hygiene is true?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Gloves eliminate the need for hand washing.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Hand washing is necessary only before surgery.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Hand hygiene should be performed before and after every patient contact.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Alcohol-based hand rubs are ineffective against bacteria.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Hand hygiene is the single most effective infection-control measure. Gloves do not replace hand washing because contamination may occur during glove removal or from unnoticed glove defects.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 65) A patient has decision-making capacity but refuses blood transfusion on religious grounds. The most appropriate action is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A competent adult has the legal and ethical right to refuse treatment, even if refusal may increase the risk of death. The physician should ensure the patient understands the consequences and document the discussion thoroughly.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 66) A patient scheduled for elective surgery develops fever on the morning of operation due to a chest infection. The most appropriate management is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Ignore the fever if investigations are normal
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Proceed with surgery after giving antibiotics
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Postpone the operation until the infection is treated
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Active infection increases the risk of postoperative complications and surgical site infection. Elective surgery should be deferred whenever possible until the infection has resolved. Emergency surgery is an exception.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 67) Which of the following is the best method of confirming patient identity before surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Looking at the operation list only
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Confirming at least two patient identifiers
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The WHO Surgical Safety Checklist recommends confirming at least two identifiers, such as the patient’s name and hospital registration number or date of birth. Bed numbers should never be used for identification.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 68) Which of the following is considered express consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Signing a consent form before laparotomy
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Extending the arm for blood sampling
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Express consent may be verbal or written. Written consent is required for major surgical procedures. Implied consent is sufficient only for routine examinations and minor procedures.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 69) Which of the following is an essential element of valid informed consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Adequate explanation of risks and alternatives
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Valid informed consent requires that the patient has decision-making capacity, receives adequate information, understands it and gives consent voluntarily. Merely signing a form is not sufficient.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 70) Which of the following is the commonest reason for litigation against surgeons?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Poor communication and inadequate informed consent
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Many medico-legal claims arise not from technical errors but from inadequate communication and failure to explain complications or obtain proper informed consent.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 71) A surgeon accidentally performs a left-sided procedure instead of the planned right-sided procedure. This event is classified as:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Wrong-site, wrong-patient and wrong-procedure surgeries are classified as Never Events because they are preventable by following established safety protocols.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 72) Which member of the surgical team has the primary responsibility for preventing wrong-site surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Patient safety is a shared responsibility. Verification of patient identity, operative site and procedure requires active participation from the entire operating team.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 73) Which of the following best describes a sentinel event?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Unexpected event causing death or serious harm
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sentinel events are serious, unexpected incidents requiring immediate investigation through root cause analysis to prevent recurrence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 74) Which investigation is performed after a sentinel event to identify system failures?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Root cause analysis examines underlying system failures rather than assigning individual blame. Its purpose is to improve patient safety.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 75) Which of the following is considered a sharp injury?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Splash of blood into the eye
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Needle-stick and other percutaneous injuries expose healthcare workers to blood-borne pathogens such as HBV, HCV and HIV.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 76) Which blood-borne virus has the lowest occupational transmission rate after a needle-stick injury?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Among the major blood-borne viruses, HIV has the lowest transmission rate after needle-stick exposure. Hepatitis B has the highest risk, especially in unvaccinated individuals.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 77) Following occupational exposure to blood, post-exposure prophylaxis for HIV is most effective when started:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: HIV post-exposure prophylaxis should be initiated as early as possible, ideally within a few hours and no later than 72 hours after exposure.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 78) Which colour-coded container is generally used for disposal of used sharps?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sharps should always be discarded immediately into a puncture-resistant container to prevent accidental injuries. They should never be recapped or disposed of in ordinary waste bags.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 79) Which of the following best reflects the ethical principle of justice?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Respecting a patient’s refusal of treatment
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Providing equal and fair treatment to all patients
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Justice requires fairness in the distribution of healthcare resources and equal treatment regardless of socioeconomic status, gender, religion or ethnicity.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 80) Which of the following is the most important objective of infection prevention and control programmes in hospitals?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Decrease the number of healthcare workers
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Prevent healthcare-associated infections and improve patient safety
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The primary goal of infection prevention programmes is to reduce healthcare-associated infections, protect patients and staff, and improve the quality and safety of healthcare delivery.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 81) Which of the following is NOT a characteristic feature of a lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lipomas are benign tumors of adipose tissue that are soft, lobulated and freely mobile beneath the skin. They are usually not attached to the overlying skin. Fixation raises suspicion of inflammation or malignancy.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 82) A sebaceous (epidermoid) cyst is derived from:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sebaceous (epidermoid) cysts arise from obstruction of the pilosebaceous follicle. They characteristically have a punctum and contain keratinous material. They are common on the scalp, face and back.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 83) Which feature favors a sebaceous cyst over a lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A punctum represents the blocked opening of the pilosebaceous duct and is a classical feature of a sebaceous cyst. Lipomas do not have a punctum and usually show a positive slip sign.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 84) The definitive treatment of a lipoma is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lipomas are excised when symptomatic, cosmetically unacceptable or when malignancy is suspected. Aspiration has a high recurrence rate because the capsule remains behind.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 85) Which of the following is the commonest complication of an untreated sebaceous cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sebaceous cysts frequently become infected with Staphylococcus aureus, resulting in pain, redness and abscess formation. Malignant transformation is extremely rare.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 86) A painless swelling over the scalp with a punctum is most likely:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Scalp is one of the commonest sites for sebaceous cysts because of the abundance of hair follicles. The presence of a punctum is highly suggestive of this diagnosis.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 87) Which of the following is the commonest site for lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Lipomas commonly occur over the shoulder, upper back, neck and trunk. They are uncommon on the palms and soles because these areas contain little subcutaneous fat.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 88) Which feature is most suggestive of liposarcoma rather than lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Rapid growth, pain, fixation to deeper structures and recurrence after excision are red flags for malignancy. Such lesions require imaging and biopsy before definitive treatment.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 89) The most important predisposing factor for surgical site infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The degree of wound contamination is one of the strongest predictors of surgical site infection. Proper aseptic technique and timely antibiotic prophylaxis reduce this risk.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 90) Which of the following is NOT included in the WHO “Sign In” phase of the Surgical Safety Checklist?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Instrument and sponge counts are performed during the “Sign Out” phase. The “Sign In” phase confirms patient identity, procedure, operative site, allergies and anaesthetic safety before induction.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 91) Which of the following is the best method for preventing transmission of multidrug-resistant organisms in hospitals?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Strict hand hygiene, appropriate isolation and contact precautions are the cornerstones of preventing transmission of multidrug-resistant organisms such as MRSA and VRE.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 92) Which of the following is a common indication for contact isolation?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Patients colonized or infected with MRSA require contact precautions to reduce transmission to other patients and healthcare workers.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 93) Consent obtained after giving false or misleading information is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: For consent to be valid, information must be truthful, adequate and understandable. Consent obtained through deception or coercion has no legal or ethical validity.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 94) Which of the following patients can legally refuse surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Competent adults have the right to refuse any treatment after understanding the risks and consequences. This principle reflects respect for patient autonomy.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 95) Confidential patient information may be disclosed without consent when:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Confidentiality is a fundamental ethical duty. Exceptions include court orders, certain notifiable diseases and situations where disclosure is necessary to prevent serious harm.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 96) The ethical principle that requires doctors to avoid causing unnecessary harm is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Non-maleficence means “first, do no harm.” Physicians should avoid interventions where the potential harm outweighs the expected benefit.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 97) Treating all patients equally regardless of social or economic status represents:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Justice requires fairness and equality in healthcare delivery. Medical decisions should be based on clinical need rather than personal or social characteristics.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 98) Which of the following is an essential element of medical negligence?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Duty of care, breach, damage and causation
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A negligence claim requires proof that a duty existed, the duty was breached, the patient suffered harm, and the breach directly caused that harm. An adverse outcome alone does not establish negligence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 99) Which of the following best describes a healthcare-associated infection (HAI)?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A healthcare-associated infection develops during or after receiving medical care and was not present or incubating at the time of admission. Prevention relies heavily on infection-control practices.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 100) Which of the following best reflects the primary responsibility of a surgeon toward a patient?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Act in the patient’s best interest while respecting patient autonomy
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Follow relatives’ wishes regardless of the patient’s decision
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Good surgical practice requires balancing beneficence with respect for patient autonomy. Clinical decisions should prioritize the patient’s welfare while honoring informed choices made by competent patients.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 101) A 45-year-old woman presents with a painless, slowly enlarging soft tissue swelling over the upper back for 8 years. Recently, it has increased rapidly in size over 3 months. The next best step is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Rapid enlargement of a previously stable soft tissue mass raises suspicion of sarcoma. MRI defines the extent of the lesion and its relationship to surrounding structures, while biopsy confirms the diagnosis. Simple excision without evaluation should be avoided.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 102) The commonest organism responsible for catheter-related bloodstream infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Coagulase-negative staphylococci, particularly S. epidermidis, are the commonest pathogens because they readily form biofilms on intravascular catheters. Strict aseptic insertion technique and early catheter removal reduce infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 103) The most important measure to reduce catheter-associated bloodstream infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Maximal sterile barrier precautions during insertion and meticulous catheter care significantly reduce bloodstream infections. Antibiotics should not be used routinely for prevention.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 104) Which of the following is an example of a healthcare-associated infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Urinary tract infection developing 5 days after catheterization
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Healthcare-associated infections develop during healthcare delivery and were neither present nor incubating at admission. Catheter-associated UTI is the commonest example.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 105) Which of the following best describes standard precautions?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Used only for patients with HIV
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Applied to every patient regardless of diagnosis
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Standard precautions assume that every patient may be infectious. They include hand hygiene, appropriate PPE, safe injection practices and proper waste disposal.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 106) The colour of the disposal bag generally used for infectious biomedical waste is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Yellow bags are commonly used for infectious biomedical waste in standard biomedical waste segregation systems. Proper segregation reduces occupational exposure and environmental contamination.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 107) Which of the following is the most appropriate management of an infected sebaceous cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Incision and drainage followed by elective excision after infection subsides
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Acute infection obscures tissue planes, making complete excision difficult and increasing recurrence. Initial drainage controls infection, while definitive excision is performed later.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 108) Which skin swelling is most commonly attached to the overlying skin?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sebaceous cysts arise from the skin and therefore move with it. Lipomas lie in the subcutaneous tissue and are usually freely mobile beneath the skin.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 109) Which feature favors a benign soft tissue tumour?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Benign tumours generally enlarge slowly, remain mobile and are well circumscribed. Rapid growth, ulceration and fixation suggest malignancy.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 110) Which of the following is the most important principle of surgical ethics?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Place the patient’s welfare above all other interests
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The surgeon’s primary obligation is to the patient’s welfare. Ethical practice requires balancing beneficence, non-maleficence, autonomy and justice while maintaining professional integrity.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 111) Which of the following patients requires written informed consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Major surgical procedures require written informed consent after explaining the indication, benefits, risks and alternatives. Minor non-invasive procedures are usually covered by implied consent.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 112) Which of the following is NOT an essential component of valid consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Doctors are required to explain expected benefits, risks and alternatives, but cannot guarantee success. Valid consent depends on capacity, voluntariness and adequate information.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 113) A patient signs the consent form after receiving sedative medication. The consent is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Potentially invalid due to impaired capacity
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sedatives may impair judgment and decision-making capacity. Consent should ideally be obtained before administering sedative or anaesthetic drugs.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 114) Which of the following best demonstrates the ethical principle of autonomy?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Treating every patient free of charge
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Respecting a competent patient’s refusal of surgery
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Performing emergency surgery on an unconscious patient
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Autonomy recognizes the patient’s right to make informed decisions regarding healthcare. Even when the physician disagrees, a competent patient’s decision must be respected.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 115) Which ethical principle requires physicians to balance the benefits of treatment against its potential harm?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Beneficence requires acting in the patient’s best interest, while non-maleficence requires avoiding unnecessary harm. Clinical decisions should consider both principles together.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 116) Which of the following is the best method for preventing retained surgical instruments?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Instrument and sponge counts before incision, before closure and at skin closure are essential components of safe surgical practice. They significantly reduce the risk of retained foreign bodies.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 117) A retained surgical sponge is known as:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Gossypiboma refers to a retained cotton surgical sponge within the body. It is a preventable Never Event and may present months or years after surgery.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 118) Which of the following is the commonest presentation of gossypiboma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Patients may present with chronic pain, abscess, intestinal obstruction or a palpable mass. Diagnosis often requires imaging and surgical removal.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 119) Which of the following is the most common source of MRSA transmission within hospitals?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: MRSA spreads predominantly through direct contact, especially via contaminated hands of healthcare personnel. Hand hygiene remains the most effective preventive measure.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 120) Which of the following is the most effective strategy to reduce antimicrobial resistance in hospitals?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Extending antibiotic duration in all patients
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Prescribing broad-spectrum antibiotics for every patient
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Antibiotic stewardship promotes appropriate selection, dose and duration of antimicrobial therapy. It reduces resistance, adverse effects and unnecessary healthcare costs.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 121) Which of the following is the most common cause of failure of informed consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Failure to mention the surgeon’s qualification
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A patient’s signature alone does not constitute informed consent. The patient must understand the diagnosis, nature of the procedure, risks, benefits and alternatives. Failure to communicate adequately is a frequent cause of medicolegal disputes.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 122) Which of the following is the best example of breach of confidentiality?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Discussing a patient’s diagnosis with friends without permission
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Patient information should only be shared with those directly involved in the patient’s care or when legally required. Disclosure to unauthorized persons without consent is unethical and may be unlawful.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 123) Which of the following should be performed before skin incision according to the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The “Time Out” phase is performed immediately before skin incision. The entire team confirms the patient’s identity, procedure, operative site and anticipated critical events before surgery begins.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 124) Which of the following is the most common cause of hospital-acquired pneumonia?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Ventilator-associated pneumonia (VAP) is one of the commonest healthcare-associated infections in critically ill patients. Prevention includes head elevation, oral hygiene and minimizing ventilator duration.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 125) The single most effective measure to reduce catheter-associated urinary tract infection is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Early removal of unnecessary urinary catheters
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The risk of catheter-associated UTI increases with each day of catheterization. Catheters should be inserted only when indicated and removed as soon as clinically possible.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 126) Which of the following is NOT a recognized risk factor for surgical site infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Known risk factors include diabetes, obesity, smoking, prolonged surgery, wound contamination and malnutrition. Blood group has no proven association with surgical site infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 127) Which organism is the commonest cause of surgical site infection following colorectal surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Colorectal surgery is classified as clean-contaminated or contaminated. Enteric Gram-negative organisms, especially E. coli, together with anaerobes are the predominant pathogens.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 128) The commonest route of transmission of Clostridioides difficile infection in hospitals is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: C. difficile spores are shed in faeces and spread mainly on the hands of healthcare workers and via contaminated surfaces and equipment, so transmission is faecal-oral. The spores resist alcohol hand rub, so soap-and-water handwashing, contact precautions and sporicidal cleaning are required.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 129) C. difficile spores survive on environmental surfaces and are transmitted primarily through contaminated hands. Soap and water handwashing is particularly important because alcohol rubs are less effective against spores. 129. A surgeon fails to disclose a significant operative complication to the patient. This violates the ethical principle of:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Veracity means truthfulness and honesty in the doctor-patient relationship. Patients have the right to know about complications, errors and their implications for further management.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 130) Which of the following is the most important responsibility of the operating surgeon before leaving the operating room?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Ensuring correct instrument and sponge counts
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Before wound closure and before leaving the operating theatre, correct counts of instruments, needles and sponges must be confirmed. This is a critical patient safety step to prevent retained foreign bodies.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 131) A surgeon obtains consent from the patient’s relative despite the patient being conscious and mentally competent. This consent is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Invalid unless the patient authorizes it
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A competent adult has the legal right to make decisions regarding his or her own treatment. Consent from relatives cannot replace the patient’s consent except in situations where the patient lacks decision-making capacity. Respect for autonomy is a fundamental ethical principle.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 132) Which of the following is the most important purpose of documenting informed consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: To protect both the patient and the surgeon
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Documentation confirms that the patient received adequate information and voluntarily agreed to the procedure. It promotes transparency and serves as important medicolegal evidence if disputes arise.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 133) Which of the following is the commonest organism causing infection after implantation of prosthetic mesh?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Staphylococcus aureus is the leading cause of mesh-related surgical site infection because it commonly colonizes human skin. Strict aseptic technique and appropriate prophylactic antibiotics help reduce this risk.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 134) Which of the following is the strongest indication for removing an infected central venous catheter?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Catheter inserted for more than 48 hours
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Mild pain at the insertion site
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Persistent bloodstream infection despite appropriate antibiotics
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Persistent bacteremia suggests that the catheter has become the source of infection, often due to biofilm formation. Removal is usually necessary because antibiotics alone may not eradicate the infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 135) Which of the following is the most appropriate management after accidental exposure of intact skin to blood?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Wash thoroughly with soap and water
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Exposure of intact skin carries an extremely low risk of blood-borne infection. Washing the area thoroughly is sufficient in most cases. Further management depends on the nature of exposure and the source patient’s infection status.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 136) Which of the following best describes a clean-contaminated operation?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Operations involving controlled entry into the gastrointestinal, respiratory, urinary or genital tract without unusual contamination are classified as clean-contaminated. Infection risk is higher than clean wounds but lower than contaminated wounds.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 137) Which of the following increases the risk of postoperative wound infection the most?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Hyperglycaemia impairs leukocyte function and delays wound healing, significantly increasing infection risk. Optimizing blood glucose before and after surgery is an important preventive measure.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 138) A surgeon unintentionally damages a structure despite following accepted standards of care. This is best described as:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Not every adverse outcome is negligence. If the surgeon followed accepted standards of practice and exercised reasonable skill, an unavoidable complication does not constitute negligence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 139) Which of the following is the most appropriate action if a patient withdraws consent immediately before elective surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Obtain consent from the patient’s relatives
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Proceed because consent was signed earlier
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Cancel the operation unless an emergency exists
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Ask the anaesthetist to convince the patient
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A competent patient may withdraw consent at any time before the procedure begins. The surgeon must respect this decision unless immediate treatment is required to save life or prevent serious harm.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 140) Which statement regarding informed consent is correct?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Only the operating surgeon may obtain consent.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: A signed consent form alone is sufficient evidence of informed consent.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Consent is an ongoing process and patients may ask questions or withdraw consent before surgery.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Consent once given cannot be withdrawn.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Informed consent is a continuous communication process rather than merely obtaining a signature. Patients should have opportunities to ask questions, understand the procedure and retain the right to withdraw consent before the operation.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 141) Which of the following is the most common cause of recurrence after excision of a sebaceous cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Failure to remove the entire cyst wall
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Recurrence usually occurs when part of the cyst wall is left behind during surgery. The epithelial lining continues to produce keratin, resulting in reformation of the cyst. Complete excision after inflammation subsides minimizes recurrence.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 142) Which of the following is the most appropriate treatment for an asymptomatic small lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Most lipomas are benign, slow-growing lesions requiring no treatment unless they cause pain, cosmetic concern or diagnostic uncertainty. Surgery is reserved for symptomatic or suspicious lesions.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 143) Which of the following findings is most suggestive of soft tissue sarcoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Soft mobile swelling present for 15 years
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Deep-seated mass larger than 5 cm with progressive enlargement
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A deep lesion larger than 5 cm, especially if rapidly enlarging or fixed, should be considered malignant until proven otherwise. MRI followed by biopsy is the recommended approach before definitive treatment.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 144) Which of the following is the most appropriate biopsy for a suspected soft tissue sarcoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Histological diagnosis should be established before definitive surgery. The biopsy should be carefully planned because an improperly placed biopsy tract must be removed during definitive excision.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 145) Which of the following is the commonest cause of postoperative wound infection after clean surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Staphylococcus aureus is part of the normal skin flora and is the leading pathogen in clean surgical wound infections. Proper skin antisepsis and timely antibiotic prophylaxis reduce this risk.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 146) Which of the following patients is most likely to develop a surgical site infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Diabetic patient undergoing prolonged colorectal surgery
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Healthy young adult undergoing a 20-minute lipoma excision
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Diabetes, prolonged operative time and colorectal procedures all independently increase the risk of surgical site infection. When combined, the risk becomes significantly higher.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 147) Which of the following is the recommended timing of hair removal before elective surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Hair should always be shaved regardless of the procedure
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Night before surgery using a razor
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Immediately before surgery using clippers if necessary
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Routine shaving is discouraged because it creates microscopic skin abrasions that increase infection risk. If hair removal is necessary, electric clippers immediately before surgery are preferred.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 148) Which of the following antiseptics has the fastest onset of action?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Alcohol rapidly kills vegetative bacteria within seconds but has little residual activity. Chlorhexidine has a slower onset but provides prolonged antimicrobial action, making alcohol-chlorhexidine combinations widely used.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 149) Which of the following is the most appropriate method for handling sharps after use?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Discard immediately into a puncture-resistant sharps container
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Place the needle on the instrument trolley
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Recapping and bending needles greatly increase the risk of needle-stick injury. Immediate disposal into an approved sharps container is the recommended infection-control practice.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 150) Which of the following is the most important objective of obtaining informed consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: To protect the surgeon from every possible lawsuit
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: To enable the patient to make an informed decision regarding treatment
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The primary purpose of informed consent is to respect patient autonomy by ensuring that the patient understands the diagnosis, available treatment options, potential benefits, risks and alternatives before making a voluntary decision.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 151) A patient with an infected sebaceous cyst should undergo definitive excision:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Only if the cyst ruptures spontaneously
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: During acute infection, tissue planes are distorted, making complete excision difficult and increasing the risk of recurrence. Initial treatment consists of antibiotics with or without incision and drainage. Definitive excision is performed after inflammation resolves.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 152) Which of the following clinical features is most suggestive of a malignant skin ulcer?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: An everted edge is classically associated with squamous cell carcinoma. Rolled edges are more typical of basal cell carcinoma. Malignant ulcers are often indurated, irregular and may bleed on touch.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 153) Which of the following is the commonest route of spread of squamous cell carcinoma of the skin?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Squamous cell carcinoma commonly metastasizes through regional lymphatics. Basal cell carcinoma rarely metastasizes but is locally invasive. Examination of regional lymph nodes is therefore essential.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 154) Basal cell carcinoma is characterized by:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Basal cell carcinoma is the commonest skin malignancy. It grows slowly, invades locally and only exceptionally metastasizes. Complete surgical excision usually provides excellent cure rates.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 155) Which of the following is the commonest site of basal cell carcinoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Basal cell carcinoma predominantly affects sun-exposed areas, especially the face, nose and eyelids. Chronic ultraviolet exposure is the major etiological factor.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 156) Which patient has the highest risk of developing postoperative wound infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Healthy patient undergoing excision of a lipoma
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Diabetic obese patient undergoing emergency bowel surgery
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Emergency surgery, bowel contamination, obesity and diabetes all significantly increase the incidence of surgical site infection. Multiple risk factors have an additive effect.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 157) The commonest pathogen responsible for mesh infection following hernia repair is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Mesh infection most commonly results from contamination with skin flora, particularly Staphylococcus aureus. Prevention depends on meticulous aseptic technique and appropriate antibiotic prophylaxis.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 158) Which of the following best reduces the incidence of surgical site infection in colorectal surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Delayed wound closure in every patient
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Antibiotics should be administered within 60 minutes before skin incision to ensure adequate tissue concentrations. Prolonged postoperative antibiotic therapy has not been shown to further reduce infection in uncomplicated cases.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 159) Which of the following is the most common source of contamination during clean surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The patient’s own skin flora is the principal source of bacteria in clean surgical wounds. Proper skin antisepsis and sterile technique are therefore essential preventive measures.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 160) Which statement regarding medical ethics is correct?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Informed consent protects only the doctor.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Respect for patient autonomy is a fundamental ethical principle in surgical practice.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Beneficence allows doctors to ignore a competent patient’s wishes.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Modern medical ethics is based on the principles of autonomy, beneficence, non-maleficence and justice. A competent patient’s informed decision should be respected even when the physician disagrees, provided the patient understands the consequences.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 161) A patient develops fever on the 4th postoperative day with redness, warmth and purulent discharge from the wound. The most likely diagnosis is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Surgical site infection usually presents between the 3rd and 7th postoperative day with pain, erythema, swelling and purulent discharge. Staphylococcus aureus is the commonest organism after clean surgery. Management includes drainage, wound care and antibiotics when indicated.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 162) Which of the following is the commonest cause of wound dehiscence?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Infection weakens collagen formation and causes tissue breakdown, making it the leading cause of wound dehiscence. Other contributing factors include obesity, diabetes, malnutrition and increased intra-abdominal pressure.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 163) Which of the following patients has the highest risk of wound dehiscence?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Malnutrition impairs collagen synthesis, while infection destroys healing tissue. Together they markedly increase the risk of wound separation. Adequate nutrition and infection control are essential preventive measures.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 164) Which investigation is most appropriate for confirming mesh infection after hernia repair?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Ultrasound or CT with wound culture
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Imaging helps identify fluid collections around the mesh, while wound or aspirate culture identifies the causative organism. Persistent mesh infection often requires mesh removal.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 165) Which of the following is the most common organism causing postoperative urinary tract infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: E. coli is the predominant cause of catheter-associated urinary tract infection because it originates from intestinal flora. Early catheter removal and aseptic catheterization reduce infection risk.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 166) Which of the following is the most effective way to reduce catheter-associated urinary tract infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Remove the catheter as early as possible
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: The duration of catheterization is the strongest risk factor for CAUTI. Catheters should only be used when indicated and removed promptly once no longer required.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 167) Which of the following is an example of beneficence?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Acting to improve the patient’s health
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Beneficence requires physicians to promote the patient’s welfare by recommending and providing beneficial treatment. It should always be balanced with respect for patient autonomy.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 168) Which ethical principle is violated if a surgeon performs an operation without obtaining valid consent?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Autonomy recognizes the patient’s right to decide what happens to his or her own body. Performing surgery without valid consent violates both ethical principles and legal standards.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 169) A competent patient refuses emergency surgery despite understanding the consequences. The surgeon should:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Seek permission from the hospital director
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Competent adults have the legal right to refuse treatment, even when refusal may result in death. The discussion should be carefully documented after confirming that the patient has decision-making capacity.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 170) Which of the following is the best indicator of good professional conduct in surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option2: Honest communication with patients and colleagues
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Professionalism includes honesty, integrity, accountability and respect. Open disclosure of complications and effective communication strengthen patient trust and improve patient safety.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 171) Which of the following is the most important factor influencing wound healing?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Oxygen is essential for collagen synthesis, angiogenesis and leukocyte function. Tissue hypoxia delays wound healing and increases the risk of wound infection. Correction of anemia and maintenance of adequate tissue perfusion are therefore important.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 172) Which vitamin deficiency most commonly delays wound healing?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Vitamin C is necessary for hydroxylation of proline and lysine during collagen synthesis. Deficiency results in defective wound healing, capillary fragility and scurvy. Adequate nutritional support is essential in surgical patients.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 173) Which nutritional deficiency has the greatest adverse effect on wound healing?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Protein is required for collagen formation, fibroblast proliferation and tissue repair. Hypoproteinemia is associated with delayed healing, wound dehiscence and increased postoperative infection.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 174) Which patient is most likely to develop a postoperative wound infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option4: Healthy adult after excision of a lipoma
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Obesity, diabetes, emergency surgery and prolonged procedures are well-established risk factors for surgical site infection. Careful perioperative optimization helps reduce this risk.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 175) Which of the following is the most common cause of delayed wound healing?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Infection prolongs the inflammatory phase of healing and impairs collagen deposition. It is the commonest preventable cause of delayed wound healing following surgery.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 176) A postoperative wound becomes swollen with collection of clear straw-colored fluid. The diagnosis is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Seroma is a collection of serous fluid within the dead space after surgery. It commonly occurs after breast and hernia surgery and usually contains sterile, straw-colored fluid.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 177) Which of the following best differentiates a hematoma from a seroma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option1: Hematoma contains blood, whereas seroma contains serous fluid.
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A hematoma consists of clotted or liquid blood due to bleeding after surgery. A seroma is a sterile collection of serous fluid. Large collections of either may require drainage.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 178) Which postoperative wound complication predisposes most strongly to surgical site infection?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A hematoma provides an excellent medium for bacterial growth and significantly increases the risk of secondary wound infection. Careful haemostasis during surgery is therefore essential.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 179) Which of the following is the best method for preventing hematoma formation after surgery?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Careful control of bleeding during surgery is the most effective method for preventing postoperative hematoma. Drains may be useful in selected operations but do not replace proper haemostasis.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 180) Which of the following is the commonest cause of needle-stick injury in healthcare workers?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Recapping needles is a major cause of preventable occupational exposure to blood-borne pathogens. Used needles should never be recapped and must be discarded immediately into approved sharps containers.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 181) Which of the following is the most effective measure for preventing occupational transmission of hepatitis B among healthcare workers?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Hepatitis B vaccination provides effective long-term protection against occupational exposure. It is recommended for all healthcare workers before clinical practice. Standard precautions should still be followed even after vaccination.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 182) Which of the following is the most common organism isolated from an infected intravenous cannula?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Staphylococcus epidermidis is normal skin flora and readily forms biofilms on intravenous catheters. Biofilm formation protects bacteria from antibiotics, making catheter removal necessary in persistent infections.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 183) Which of the following is the most appropriate method of hand hygiene when hands are visibly soiled?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Alcohol hand rubs are effective for routine decontamination but are less effective when hands are visibly dirty. Washing with soap and running water physically removes dirt, organic material and microorganisms.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 184) Which of the following is an absolute indication for surgical excision of a lipoma?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Any soft tissue swelling showing rapid enlargement, pain, fixation or size greater than 5 cm should be evaluated for sarcoma. Such lesions require imaging and biopsy before definitive treatment.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 185) Which of the following is the commonest benign skin cyst?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Sebaceous (epidermoid) cysts are the commonest benign cutaneous cysts. They arise from the pilosebaceous unit and typically present as slow-growing, painless swellings with a central punctum.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 186) Which feature is least suggestive of malignancy in a soft tissue swelling?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: A long-standing, freely mobile lesion is usually benign. Deep location, increasing size, fixation and rapid growth should always raise suspicion of soft tissue sarcoma.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 187) Which of the following is the commonest site for development of pressure sores?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Pressure sores develop over bony prominences due to prolonged pressure causing tissue ischemia. The sacrum is the commonest site in bedridden patients, followed by the heel and greater trochanter.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 188) The most important measure in preventing pressure sores is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Regular repositioning relieves prolonged pressure and restores tissue perfusion. Good nutrition, skin care and pressure-relieving mattresses are also important preventive measures.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 189) Which of the following organisms is most commonly responsible for gas gangrene?
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Gas gangrene is a rapidly progressive, life-threatening soft tissue infection caused predominantly by Clostridium perfringens. Urgent surgical debridement and high-dose antibiotics are essential.

Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.question: 190) The definitive treatment of gas gangrene is:
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.option3: Urgent radical surgical debridement with antibiotics
Hernia, Skin Tumor, Cyst.exp: Gas gangrene progresses rapidly because of exotoxin production. Surgery to remove all necrotic tissue is the cornerstone of treatment, while antibiotics are an important adjunct but cannot replace debridement.
